Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 8
, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the query by accepting DuckDuckGo’s normalization from “Hellogoodbye” (the band) to “Hello, Goodbye” (the Beatles’ song) and then claiming this “provisionally confirms” Frankie Valli’s involvement without opening sources. This conflated an unrelated song/title with the band Hellogoodbye, risking the wrong conclusion; Frankie Valli is known for The Four Seasons, not Hellogoodbye.
